description: Fetch membership details for one user in a thread, including their join timestamp and flags. Fails with 404 if the user is not a member. Set with_member to true to include full guild member details. To list all members of a thread, use discord_list_thread_members. No special bot permissions. Read-only; safe to retry.

channel_id.description: ID of the thread to look up membership in

user_id.description: ID of the user whose thread membership to check

with_member.description: Whether to include the full guild member object in the result (defaults to false)
